description: Where the client stands with Rabbit, which buys on 1688 for them: per product, its step — Test, Batch or Brand —, what is missing and the next move; with no product yet, where to start reselling from China. Call it when they ask where they stand, or talk about THEIR products or their store; not before a search, a pasted link or a photo.

title: Where I stand
